unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Tall pine trees grow proudly on the snowy mountain slopes.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 高大的松树骄傲地生长在白雪皑皑的山坡上。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：pine tree 松树。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 管子；管道 `v.` 用管道输送
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Water pipes were broken.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 水管破裂了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：形似一根管子，两个p夹着i，再跟一个e。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 平原 `adj.` 简单的；朴素的；清楚的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The ancient soldiers rode their horses across the vast grassy plain.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 古代士兵们骑着马驰骋在广阔的草原上。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：plain clothes 便服，朴素的衣服。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 故事情节；小块土地 `v.` 密谋
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The novel has an exciting plot with plenty of surprising twists.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这部小说的情节惊险刺激，有许多意想不到的转折。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 文学术语：story plot 故事情节。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `prep.` 加；加上 `conj.` 而且 `n.` 加号
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Two plus three equals five.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 二加三等于五。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 数学符号：plus sign 加号。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The national flag was raised slowly to the top of the pole.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 国旗缓缓升到旗杆顶部。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 地理名词：the North Pole 北极；flag pole 旗杆。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Honesty is always the best policy in friendship and life.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在友谊和生活中，诚实永远是上策。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 英语名言：Honesty is the best policy (诚信至上)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He spent half an hour polishing his leather shoes until they shone.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他花了半个小时擦皮鞋，直到它们闪闪发光。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：polish your essay 润色文章。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Emma usually asks politely, "Would you like some?"
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 艾玛通常会礼貌地问：“你想来一点吗？”
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：polite（有礼貌的）+ ly（副词后缀）-> 礼貌地。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I prefer helping others.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我更喜欢帮助别人。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：pre（在前面）+ fer（带来，带去）-> 提到前面来，即更喜欢。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 准备工作；课外作业 `v.` 准备
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She spent the whole evening doing exam prep in the study.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她整个晚上都在书房里做考试准备。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词汇缩写：preparation 的口语简称 -> prep。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The TV presenter introduced the famous scientist to the audience.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 电视节目主持人把这位著名的科学家介绍给观众。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：present (展示) + er -> 主持人。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 首要的，主要的；优质的 `n.` 鼎盛时期
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Safety is of prime importance in every chemistry experiment.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在每个化学实验中，安全都是首要的。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 常用短语：prime minister 总理，首相。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Movable-type printing is one of ancient China's four great inventions.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 活字印刷术是中国古代四大发明之一。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 四大发明：printing (印刷术)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Make sure you wear proper sports shoes before going jogging.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 去慢跑之前，确保你穿了合适的运动鞋。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：properly 合适地 -> proper 合适的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: His outstanding results proved that hard work always pays off.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他优异的成绩证明了努力总会有回报。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：prove oneself 证明自己。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The children put on yellow rain boots and splashed in the rain puddle.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 孩子们穿上黄色的雨靴，在雨水坑里溅水玩。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：rain puddle 雨后小水坑。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 用泵输送；打气 `n.` 泵；抽水机
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The heart pumps fresh blood to all parts of the human body.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 心脏将新鲜血液泵送至人体的各个部位。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 生活常识：pump air into a bike tire 给自行车轮胎打气。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 低沉柔和地讲话；(猫)发出呼噜声
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They did not like him because he could not purr or lay eggs!
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他们不喜欢他是因为他既不会发出呼噜声也不会下蛋！
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拟声词：猫满足时发的**呼噜声**。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Don't jump the queue.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 不要插队。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 字母Q的发音，排队的人形就像一个Q。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The boy dreams of becoming a professional car racing driver.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这个男孩梦想成为一名职业赛车手。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 体育项目：horse racing 赛马；car racing 赛车。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Whose tennis racket is it? How do you know?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这把网球拍是谁的？你怎么知道？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀法：rack(架子) + -et(小的后缀) -> 小架子一样的网 -> 球拍

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The giant panda is one of the rarest wild animals in the world.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 大熊猫是世界上最珍稀的野生动物之一。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：rare plant 珍稀植物。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She rarely eats sweet cakes because she cares about her teeth.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她很少吃甜蛋糕，因为她很爱护牙齿。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 频率副词：never < rarely < sometimes < often < always。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 回忆起；召回 `n.` 记忆力
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I can still clearly recall the happy days we spent in the village.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我依然能清晰地回忆起我们在村子里度过的快乐日子。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 前缀记忆：re (再次) + call (呼唤) -> 再次在脑海中唤起，即回忆。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Each pupil was asked to recite an ancient Chinese poem aloud.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 每个小学生都被要求大声背诵一首中国古诗。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 学习动作：recite a poem 背诵诗歌。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should reduce plastic waste to keep our oceans clean.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们应该减少塑料垃圾以保持海洋清洁。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 环保3R原则：Reduce, Reuse, Recycle。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What do the italicised words refer to in the sentences?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 句子中斜体字指的是什么？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：re-（再）+ fer（带来）→ 再次带来信息供参考 → 提到，查阅。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 将……认为，看待 `n.` 注意，关注，尊重，尊敬
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The high regard for the Chinese writing system can be seen in the development of Chinese characters as an art form.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 人们对中国书写系统的高度推崇，可以从汉字作为一种艺术形式的发展中看出。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：re（反复）+ gard（看作guard看守，关注）→ 反复关注 → 尊重，看待。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Tibet is an autonomous region located in southwest China.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 西藏是位于中国西南的一个自治区。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 地理名词：autonomous region 自治区；polar region 极地地区。
